## What's Changed

### Status indicators
- Added per-group count, merged, and repeat styles for comments, reviews, and checks.
- Merged indicators are now the default: reviews and checks use the worst status color, with no count; comments show a single icon without a count.
- Repeated icons collapse to an icon and count above the configurable cap (default: 3).

### README and demo
- Added a GitHub star invitation and refreshed the demo recording.

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/987poiuytrewq/opencode-github-pr/compare/v0.2.0...v0.2.1

## What's Changed

### Dashboard experience
- Refined layout, title truncation, status messages, icons, colors, comments, and pagination.
- Added server-side pagination, configurable indicator spacing, and improved closed/draft PR presentation.

### GitHub data and reliability
- Improved merge/review status, supplemented search results with recent PRs, and strengthened GraphQL, authentication, and rate-limit handling.
- Added SSH alias and URL-rewrite support and fixed request, keymap, and renderer lifecycles.

### Packaging and compatibility
- Added the npm release workflow, refined package metadata, and tested packed installs.
- Expanded the OpenCode CI matrix and added broader pagination, Git-root, and E2E coverage.

### Docs and demo
- Expanded installation, configuration, and loading documentation; refreshed the demo recording.

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/987poiuytrewq/opencode-github-pr/compare/v0.1.0...v0.2.0

## What's Changed

### PR dashboard
- Introduced the OpenCode V2 sidebar dashboard, with current-branch PRs, author/status filters, pagination, and one-line titles.
- Added links from PR rows to merge status, checks, files, and the GitHub overview.

### Review and CI status
- Added merge-readiness, CI checks, review summaries, and unresolved review comment counts.
- Improved status messaging and dashboard reliability.

### Setup and compatibility
- Added linked-worktree support, GitHub CLI/token authentication, GitHub Enterprise Server support, and cross-platform browser opening.

### Polish and documentation
- Added theme-aware status presentation, installation and configuration docs, an MIT license, CI tests, and a demo recording.

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/987poiuytrewq/opencode-github-pr/compare/62513e7fc7b84af8cc91dfd77b38d978d2b0e771...v0.1.0
